user.title: Hikvision ISAPI Controls
user.description: Enter your camera/NVR credentials. **Basic** (default) includes detections, camera streams, uptime, firmware, and light diagnostics. **Advanced** adds optional extras like volumes, IR tuning, siren, and alarm controls.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of your Hikvision camera/NVR (e.g., 192.168.1.12)
data_description.verify_ssl: Verify SSL certificate (uncheck for self-signed certificate)
data_description.integration_profile: Basic is the everyday preset. Advanced keeps Basic and lets you add optional controls on top.

entity_customize.title: Choose extra entities
entity_customize.description: Basic is always on. Expand a **category** below and use its dropdown to pick entities. Collapse categories you do not need.

detections.name: Event detections
detections.description: Motion, line crossing, tamper, and other event binary sensors

essential_system.name: Maintenance extras
essential_system.description: Restart button and other maintenance controls

system_diagnostics.name: Extended diagnostics
system_diagnostics.description: Streaming sessions, clients, and notification host details

day_night.name: Day / night & IR cut
day_night.description: IR cut modes, sensitivity, filter time

siren.name: Siren
siren.description: Play camera alarm from Home Assistant

detection_switches.name: Detection on/off switches
detection_switches.description: Enable/disable detection types on the camera

two_way_audio.name: Two-way audio & speaker
two_way_audio.description: Media player, speaker/mic volume, noise reduction

alarm_io.name: Alarm input / output
alarm_io.description: Alarm input sensor and output relay

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate {name}
reauth_confirm.description: The camera rejected the stored password (common after a factory reset). Enter the current password.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure {name}
reconfigure.description: Update connection settings for this device

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of your Hikvision camera/NVR (e.g., 192.168.1.12)
data_description.verify_ssl: Verify SSL certificate (uncheck for self-signed certificate)
data_description.password: Leave blank to keep the current password, or enter a new one
data_description.integration_profile: Basic or Advanced. Advanced always includes Basic, then optional extras.
data_description.update_interval: How often to check for updates (5-300 seconds, default: 30)
data_description.set_alarm_server: Enable this to configure the camera to send event notifications to Home Assistant
data_description.alarm_server: Home Assistant URL that the camera can reach (usually http://YOUR_HA_IP:8123)
data_description.rtsp_port_forced: Force a specific RTSP port number (1-65535). Leave empty to use camera's default port.
